hooks.name: Lint + typecheck on React save (IDE)
hooks.description: When the agent edits frontend TypeScript, run ESLint and the TypeScript compiler and feed errors back.

action.command: cd frontend && npx eslint src/ --fix --quiet && npx tsc --noEmit

hooks.name: Contrast check on token change (IDE)
hooks.description: When design tokens change, verify WCAG contrast for every text and status pair in dark and light themes.
